metadata.dataset: Trail corridor parcels (Option A — statewide services only): parcels the NCT line crosses, plus the adjoining ring (one parcel deep)
metadata.method: Candidates pulled per state from the six statewide parcel services (ND NDGISHUB, MN MnGeo quarterly snapshot, WI V12, VT VCGI, NY NYS ITS, OH ODNR) within 2.5 km of the NCT centerline; crossed = line crosses/touches the parcel or passes within 1 m of its boundary; adjoining = boundary within 3 m of a crossed parcel. Selection in EPSG:5070 on full geometry; output simplified 2 m, topology-preserving. Owner name + mailing address as published in the county records (public record); taxpayer fields (values, taxes, EMV, assessment) never pulled.
metadata.display: OFF by default, lazy-loaded on first toggle; faint below zoom 3, full style at zoom 3+; crossed parcels 2px solid orange outline, adjoining 2px dashed khaki. Not suitable for accurate boundary determination (per-source disclaimer in each feature's source/vintage).
metadata.kent_mi: Kent County MI re-checked 2026-11-24: service root returns HTTP 200 but the body is {"error":{"code":499,"message":"Token Required"}} with no layers — still gated, NOT in this layer. Backfill if restored (+74.89 mi).
metadata.backfill: Not in this layer (Option A scope): MI 9 county services (+332.52 mi), PA 6 sources (+191.93 mi), Hubbard County MN fallback (+40.16 mi) — together +564.61 mi, lifting coverage from 63.7% to 75.6%. NY's 5 opt-out counties (267.39 mi) and MI's 17 no-source counties (807.90 mi) remain uncovered.
metadata.mercer_gap: Mercer County ND (3.01 trail mi) has NO parcels in this layer: 160 NDGISHUB candidates were pulled within 2.5 km of the line, but the nearest is 149.9 m from the line — the service simply has no parcels touching the trail there (a coverage hole in the source, not a tolerance issue). Covered miles are therefore 3,031.45, not the scoped 3,034.46. County mismatches (90) are border parcels whose centroid falls in the neighbouring county; the service county is kept as authoritative.
